name: Weihua Sheng
title: Professor; Earl & Carolyn Glimp Professorship for ECE
department: School of Electrical and Computer Engineering; Advanced Sensing, Computation and Control Laboratory
fitReason: Strong algorithmic HRI fit: context-sensitive companion robots, learned dialogue adaptation and personalized assistance. The current official ECE directory verifies Professor and the named professorship, superseding the older ASCC opportunities page’s Associate Professor wording. Official student news independently identifies first author Zhidong Su as his doctoral advisee.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full ICRA 2024 ChatAdp demonstrates the ASCC companion robot with CNN scene/sound recognition, DQN dialogue and an LLM-based user simulator. Five participants interacted in the apartment-like testbed. Tablet-selected context and played activity sounds staged parts of the test. The reported 92% is simulated evaluation after user feedback, not physical-task success. The two adaptation “days” fit an approximately 20-minute participant session. No learned navigation or manipulation is established. The 2026 CACAS paper reports further real-user testing, but its full latest methods were not retrieved.

shortVisit.summary: The official ASCC opportunity page recruits PhD research assistants starting Fall 2019 and local graduate teaching assistants. Its stale dates and degree-specific requirements are not an outside-master short-visit invitation. No separate current visitor, remote or summer 2027 offer was verified.

name: Zhidong Su
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Current independent CSU Pueblo faculty member since 2024, with first-author adaptive social-robot learning and a current local AI-Assisted Proactive Companion Robot project. Particularly relevant to multimodal context recognition, language-based user modeling and human feedback. Do not confuse Pueblo with CSU Fort Collins.

physicalEvidence.summary: First author of the fully inspected 2024 ChatAdp physical companion-robot study conducted at prior Oklahoma State. It combines learned perception and adaptive dialogue, with staged context and simulated quantitative evaluation. This establishes hands-on prior-site experience, not current Pueblo-owned hardware. The local Discovery Scholars project now proposes home-observation data collection and AI-assisted support decisions; it does not yet prove a completed new local learned controller.

shortVisit.summary: Current official Discovery Scholars listing names Su as faculty mentor for an AI companion-robot project, within the local academic-year program. It does not invite external master’s summer visitors. No lab-specific visiting, remote, eight-week or summer 2027 offer was found.
